top_signals.summary: Global bond yields are at their highest level since 2008, with the 30-year US Treasury touching 5% just before Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced a surprise increase of his department’s bond buyback program and Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh made his hawkish speech at Jackson Hole.
